tasks.reason: The user explicitly requested an upgrade to the latest LTS version. .NET 8.0 support ends in November 2026; upgrading to .NET 10.0 LTS ensures continued long-term support, security updates, and access to the latest runtime performance improvements and language features.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade the entire eShopOnWeb solution (6 application projects and 4 test projects) from net8.0 to net10.0. This includes updating the TargetFramework in Directory.Build.props, updating the .NET SDK version in global.json, updating all version-aligned NuGet packages (Microsoft.AspNetCore.*, Microsoft.EntityFrameworkCore.*, Microsoft.Extensions.*, and related packages), and resolving any API breaking changes introduced between .NET 8 and .NET 10.
tasks.summary: Upgraded eShopOnWeb from .NET 8.0 to .NET 10.0 LTS. Updated global.json SDK version, bumped all version-aligned NuGet packages in Directory.Packages.props, removed obsolete serialization constructor, fixed xUnit test warnings, resolved PublicApiIntegrationTests Program ambiguity with extern alias. All 74 tests pass across UnitTests, IntegrationTests, FunctionalTests, and PublicApiIntegrationTests.
